title: KRBTGT PASSWORD RESET ON DOMAIN CONTROLLERS
subtitle: DISA STIG V-254427 · WN22-DC-000430
TWO RESETS PER CYCLE
WAIT >= TICKET LIFETIME
POWERSHELL 7 (5.1 OK)
AD MODULE ONLY
description: A management computer (or a domain controller) runs Reset-KrbtgtPassword.ps1. The read-only pre-flight reads the domain, the PDC emulator, every writable DC, the krbtgt account and its unicodePwd replication version, the Kerberos policy from SYSVOL and the replication health. A reset is performed on the PDC emulator, replicated with Sync-ADObject to every writable DC and verified there. The Kerberos clients and services keep working after reset 1 because the password history holds two keys; after reset 2 every ticket issued before reset 1 is rejected. The lower panel shows the two-reset cycle, the compromise mode and the STIG outcome for V-254427 / WN22-DC-000430 and its Server 2025, 2019 and 2016 equivalents.

badge.text: Windows Server 2022 STIG V2R11 · 30 Sep 2026 · CAT II

container.label: Active Directory domain
container.note: the management computer or a DC runs the script · the PDC emulator takes the reset · every writable DC is verified

cards.title: MANAGEMENT COMPUTER
cards.subtitle: PAW / jump host or a DC · runs the script

sections.label: Role
sections.text: Runs Reset-KrbtgtPassword.ps1 with the ActiveDirectory module over LDAP; no agent, no download, no other tool

sections.label: Pre-flight · read-only
bullets: PowerShell 7 or 5.1 · ActiveDirectory module
Domain, PDC emulator, writable DCs, RODCs
krbtgt by SID (RID 502) · PasswordLastSet
unicodePwd replication version + originating DC
Kerberos policy from SYSVOL GptTmpl.inf
Replication failures + partner results
LDAP bind to every writable DC

sections.label: Decides
bullets: Reset 1 of 2 or 2 of 2 (state file + AD version)
STOP if < ticket lifetime since the last reset

sections.label: Output
lines: `Logs\Reset-KrbtgtPassword-<mode>-<stamp>.log + .csv`
`Outputs\<domain>\krbtgt-state.json`
one JSON record per reset · exit 1 on Open / STOP

callout.title: no secret is ever written
callout.text: The new password is 64 random characters from a cryptographic RNG, built as a read-only SecureString, never shown, logged or hashed.

cards.footer: PS 7 OR 5.1 · RSAT AD · DOMAIN ADMIN · LDAP

cards.title: PDC EMULATOR
cards.subtitle: takes the reset · replicates to all writable DCs

sections.label: Role
sections.text: Set-ADAccountPassword -Reset on CN=krbtgt, then Sync-ADObject to every other writable DC and verification on each one

sections.label: Reset
bullets: unicodePwd version N -> N+1
PasswordLastSet = now (the STIG check value)
Verified on the PDC before anything else

sections.label: Replicate · verify
bullets: Sync-ADObject PDC -> each writable DC
Poll every DC until it shows version N+1
Up to -ReplicationTimeoutMinutes (15)
Not confirmed = FAIL, next reset refused

sections.label: Password history = 2
bullets: After reset 1: old key still accepted (N-1)
After reset 2: the pre-reset key is gone
That is why the STIG wants two resets

callout.title: no undo
callout.text: The old key cannot be restored. If something breaks, clients recover by re-authenticating; Microsoft: a reboot is the only reliable recovery.

cards.footer: WRITABLE DCs ONLY · RODC krbtgt_* NOT TOUCHED

cards.title: KERBEROS CLIENTS + SERVICES
cards.subtitle: every TGT is sealed with the krbtgt key

sections.label: Role
sections.text: Users, computers and services hold TGTs for up to MaxTicketAge (10 h) and service tickets for up to MaxServiceAge (600 min)

sections.label: After reset 1
bullets: KDCs accept tickets from key N and N-1
Nobody notices; new TGTs use the new key

sections.label: After reset 2 (>= 10 h later)
bullets: Tickets issued before reset 1 are rejected
Clients request new TGTs transparently
Stuck sessions: sign out / reboot

sections.label: -Immediate (compromise)
bullets: Both resets in one run, no wait
Every ticket in the domain is invalid at once
Users, services and computers re-authenticate

sections.label: Not affected
bullets: NTLM-authenticated connections
Open sessions, until their service ticket renews

callout.title: wait at least the ticket lifetime
callout.text: The script derives the wait from the Kerberos policy (longest of MaxTicketAge and MaxServiceAge) and refuses reset 2 before it; -MinHoursBetweenResets can only raise it.

bar.label: Default Domain Policy · Kerberos policy
bar.title: MaxTicketAge 10 h · MaxServiceAge 600 min · MaxRenewAge 7 d (Windows defaults)
bar.note: Read from \\<domain>\SYSVOL\...\{31B2F340-016D-11D2-945F-00C04FB984F9}\MACHINE\Microsoft\Windows NT\SecEdit\GptTmpl.inf, or -KerberosPolicyPath · the minimum wait between reset 1 and reset 2 is the longest lifetime

down.title: Reset flow
down.sub: management computer → PDC → every writable DC

up.title: Evidence
up.sub: read back from every DC, not from variables

panel.label: Two-reset cycle + STIG outcome

banner.title: V-254427 / WN22-DC-000430 · CAT II · CCI-000366
banner.sub: check: Get-ADUser krbtgt -Property PasswordLastSet · more than 180 days old = Open

cards.title: Check
cards.subtitle: -Mode Check · read-only
lines: PasswordLastSet age vs 180 days: Open / NotAFinding
Replication, reachability, policy, next action
Exit 1 when Open: a scheduled task can alert

cards.title: Reset 1 of 2
cards.subtitle: -Mode Reset · asks Y/N
lines: Resets on the PDC, replicates, verifies every DC
PasswordLastSet is fresh: the item is NotAFinding
State file: step 1 · unicodePwd version N+1

cards.title: Wait
cards.subtitle: >= MaxTicketAge (10 h by default)
lines: Reset 2 is refused before the wait (STOP: too soon)
Tickets sealed with key N-1 keep working meanwhile
Finish within -PairWindowDays (7) of reset 1

cards.title: Reset 2 of 2
cards.subtitle: -Mode Reset again
lines: Password history now holds only the two new keys
Golden tickets forged with the old key stop working
State file: step 2 · pair complete · due again in 180 d

cards.title: Compromise
cards.subtitle: -Mode Reset -Immediate
lines: Both resets in one run, replication verified between
Every ticket invalid: users and services re-authenticate
Use only when the krbtgt key may be stolen

cards.title: Schedule
cards.subtitle: stay NotAFinding
lines: Run Check weekly (exit 1 = Open) and keep the CSV
Run the pair every 90-180 days, before the due date
RODC krbtgt_<id> accounts: separate procedure
